notes: Lower Manhattan bbox subset (configs/nyc.yaml). Not citywide 1ft DEM.
Socrata may be blocked; ArcGIS/USGS/CDN mirrors used when needed.

Live core + optional layers present (311/Sandy/impervious/hydro when downloaded). Hydro in Lower Manhattan is mostly tidal river/waterbody — dist_stream_m is a distance-to-water proxy. event_rainfall constant grid is a scenario hook, not gauge/radar observations.

layers.name: impervious
layers.source: Esri Annual NLCD Fractional Impervious ImageServer
layers.detail: EPSG:4326 GeoTIFF, values scaled to fraction 0–1

layers.name: event_rainfall
layers.detail: Uniform 75.0 mm/h over bbox (Ida-like scenario hook; not gauge radar)

layers.name: hydro_streams
layers.detail: NHDPlus HR flowlines+areas+waterbodies; NetworkNHDFlowline=36, NonNetworkNHDFlowline=9, NHDArea=4, NHDWaterbody=69; wrote 117 after bbox clip. Honesty: mostly tidal rivers/waterbodies for LM — dist_stream_m is distance-to-water, not classic stream proximity.
